source.title: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer 2025
source.resolution: 30 m classified satellite imagery; acreage counted at native resolution inside each county; map tiles at ~60 m (z11), coarser zooms by majority
source.caveat: Satellite classification, not a field survey. Accuracy varies by crop and state; small or mixed fields are generalized on the map.
source.boundaries: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb county boundaries
